subject: Television & Streaming
title: The A-Plot, B-Plot, C-Plot Structure
description: One-minute skill: The A-Plot, B-Plot, C-Plot Structure.

hook.text: A typical TV episode juggles three stories at once: a main plot, a secondary plot, and a minor runner.

buildup.text: The A-plot carries the episode's main drama. The B-plot develops secondary characters.

discovery.text: Seinfeld mastered weaving multiple plots that converged in the final act.

twist.text: The A-Plot, B-Plot, C-Plot Structure has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Multi-plot structure is television's unique storytelling advantage over film.

punchline.text: Three stories in 42 minutes. Film can't do that.

quiz.question: What is the A-B-C plot structure in television writing?
options: Juggling a main plot, secondary plot, and minor storyline within one episode
